notes: Encoded ONLY from Liebert's own page. Parent Emerson Electric Co is a page fact, not a rule import: no rule is taken from any Emerson-brand page. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 2 ('349082-001 with Date Code: J-97') — the page states no serial positions and no month-letter/year mapping for the J-97 date code, so nothing about it is encodable from text; its page images are data-plate photos, not a decode chart. Style id keeps the page's style-1 numbering.

styles.notes: Page positions 1st & 2nd numerical digits = year, 3rd & 4th = week (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open [0,2] and [2,4]. The first four characters are all digits, so character and digit counting agree. Page example 0641N137175 decodes to 2006 week 41.
